summary: Fourteen days in Peru: Lima’s coast and food, acclimatize in Cusco, Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, Lake Titicaca, then Arequipa and Colca — paced for altitude, not a rushed checklist.

days.title: Arrival in Lima and Miraflores
days.travelHack: Official taxi or pre-booked transfer from LIM — ignore unmarked touts in the arrivals hall.
days.transportationTips: LIM to Miraflores is 45–75 min in traffic. Keep cash in soles for the first taxi if the card reader fails.

afternoon.name: Arrival at LIM and transfer to Miraflores
afternoon.description: Land, collect luggage, and transfer to the hotel.
bullets: Allow 60–90 min to Miraflores in afternoon traffic.
Keep a small USD/EUR reserve; change a little at the airport.

afternoon.name: Check-in and short break
afternoon.description: Settle in and freshen up after the long haul.
bullets: Drop bags and rest 45–60 min.
Skip a heavy first-night itinerary.

evening.name: Malecón sunset walk and dinner in Miraflores
evening.description: Cliff-top walk, then one relaxed ceviche dinner.
bullets: Walk Parque del Amor before dark.
Ceviche or causa — one dinner only.

days.title: Historic Lima and Barranco
days.travelHack: Plaza de Armas is safest by day; use a registered taxi or Uber back to Miraflores after dark.
days.transportationTips: Taxi or Metro line 1 + short walk. Don’t wander side streets with phones out.

morning.name: Plaza de Armas and the Cathedral
morning.description: Colonial core of Lima — plaza, cathedral, and government palace views.
bullets: Go early for softer light and fewer tour groups.
San Francisco monastery catacombs if you want one indoor visit.

afternoon.name: Barranco murals and the Puente de los Suspiros
afternoon.description: Lima’s bohemian district — galleries, street art, and the wooden bridge.
bullets: Coffee on a Bajada de Baños terrace.
Optional: Pedro de Osma museum if you like colonial art.

evening.name: Dinner in Barranco
evening.description: One dinner — pisco sour and a simple criollo plate.
bullets: Stay in Barranco or taxi back to Miraflores.

days.title: Flight to Cusco and acclimatize
days.travelHack: First afternoon in Cusco is for altitude — walk slowly, drink coca tea, no big hikes.
days.transportationTips: LIM–CUZ is ~1h 20min. Taxi from CUZ to the historic center ~25 min.
days.localWarnings: Altitude ~3,400 m. Skip alcohol the first night.

morning.name: Domestic flight Lima to Cusco
morning.description: Short hop over the Andes to CUZ.
bullets: Keep a layer in the cabin — it gets cold on descent.
Window seat on the left often has mountain views.

afternoon.name: Check-in and a slow Plaza de Armas loop
afternoon.description: Light walk only — get used to the altitude.
bullets: Sit on the plaza, don’t climb Sacsayhuamán today.
Coca tea at the hotel is normal, not a tourist gimmick.

evening.name: Early dinner near the plaza
evening.description: One light dinner — soup or quinoa, not a heavy steak.
bullets: Eat early and sleep.

days.title: Cusco on foot
days.travelHack: Buy the boleto turístico only if you will use two or more included sites.
days.transportationTips: The center is walkable. Taxis for the short hop to Qorikancha if tired.

morning.name: Qorikancha and Avenida El Sol
morning.description: Inca stonework under the Santo Domingo convent.
bullets: Go at opening to avoid cruise-day crowds.
Look at the curved wall — the famous tight-fit masonry.

afternoon.name: San Blas workshops and viewpoints
afternoon.description: Steep lanes, artisan studios, and a view back over the roofs.
bullets: Climb slowly — this is still acclimatization.
Optional short visit to San Blas church.

evening.name: Dinner in San Blas
evening.description: One dinner — Andean tasting plate or a simple trout.
bullets: Book if the place is popular after 19:00.

days.title: Sacred Valley — Pisac and Ollantaytambo
days.travelHack: Sleep in Ollantaytambo tonight — the morning train to Machu Picchu is calmer from here than from Cusco.
days.transportationTips: Private driver or shared van Cusco → Pisac → Ollantaytambo (~full day).

morning.name: Pisac ruins and market
morning.description: Terraces above the village, then a short market walk.
bullets: Ruins first, market after — fewer buses at opening.
Bargain politely; start well below the first price.

afternoon.name: Ollantaytambo fortress
afternoon.description: Steep terraces and the temple of the sun at the valley pinch-point.
bullets: The climb is short but high — go slow.
Check in at the hotel before the last light.

evening.name: Dinner in Ollantaytambo
evening.description: One dinner on the plaza — early night before the train.
bullets: Pack a small bag for Machu Picchu; leave the rest at the hotel.

days.title: Machu Picchu
days.travelHack: Tickets are timed circuits — buy official tickets in advance. No large bags on site.
days.transportationTips: Train Ollantaytambo → Aguas Calientes, then the official bus up to the citadel.
days.localWarnings: Drones and climbing off-circuit are fined. Bring a rain layer.

morning.name: Train and bus to Machu Picchu
morning.description: Early train, then the switchback bus to the gate.
bullets: Be at the station 30 min early.
Keep your passport with the ticket.

morning.name: Machu Picchu citadel circuit
morning.description: Guided or self-guided circuit through the terraces and temples.
bullets: A licensed guide for 2 hours is worth it on a first visit.
Huayna Picchu only if you booked that ticket months ahead.

afternoon.name: Return to Aguas Calientes and train back
afternoon.description: Bus down, a short break, afternoon train to Ollantaytambo or Cusco.
bullets: Eat a simple lunch in town if you skipped food on site.
Confirm which station you booked for the return.

evening.name: Dinner after the train
evening.description: One dinner in Ollantaytambo or Cusco — keep it simple.
bullets: Sleep — tomorrow is a travel day.

days.title: Cusco buffer and Sacsayhuamán
days.travelHack: If yesterday ran late, this is your recovery day — Sacsayhuamán is optional, not mandatory.
days.transportationTips: Taxi up to Sacsayhuamán, walk down to the plaza (20–30 min downhill).

morning.name: Sacsayhuamán zigzag walls
morning.description: Massive fitted stones above Cusco — one of the best Inca sites after Machu Picchu.
bullets: Go in the morning before the sun is harsh.
Included on the boleto turístico.

afternoon.name: San Pedro market and a slow café
afternoon.description: Fruit juices, textiles, and a pause before tomorrow’s bus to Puno.
bullets: Watch bags in the aisles.
Buy coca sweets for the high-altitude bus, not heavy souvenirs.

evening.name: Dinner in Cusco
evening.description: One Andean dinner — roast chicken or a tasting menu if you booked.
bullets: Pack tonight; tourist bus to Puno leaves early.

days.title: Andean tourist bus to Puno
days.travelHack: Book the tourist bus (Inka Express / similar), not the cheap night coach — stops at Andahuaylillas and Raqchi break the 3,800 m climb.
days.transportationTips: Cusco → Puno tourist bus ~8–10 h with ruins stops. Bring a layer; the Altiplano is cold even in sun.
days.localWarnings: Puno sits at ~3,800 m. Walk slowly on arrival. Skip alcohol.

morning.name: Tourist bus Cusco to Puno
morning.description: Day bus across the Altiplano with short ruin and chapel stops.
bullets: Andahuaylillas chapel and Raqchi are the usual pauses.
Keep water and coca sweets in the day bag.

afternoon.name: Arrival in Puno and lakeside check-in
afternoon.description: Settle near the waterfront. No extra sightseeing tonight.
bullets: A short walk on the malecón is enough.
Confirm tomorrow’s Uros / Taquile boat time.

evening.name: Early dinner in Puno
evening.description: One light dinner — trout or quinoa soup.
bullets: Sleep early; the lake boat leaves in the morning.

days.title: Lake Titicaca — Uros and Taquile
days.travelHack: A full-day boat with Uros plus Taquile is enough — skip the overnight homestay unless you want a slower pace.
days.transportationTips: Shared boat from Puno harbour. Sun is harsh on the water; bring a hat and SPF.

morning.name: Uros floating islands
morning.description: Reed islands on the lake — a short visit, then on to Taquile.
bullets: Stay 30–40 min; the sales pitch is part of the stop.
Pay in soles if you buy a small reed souvenir.

afternoon.name: Taquile island walk and lunch
afternoon.description: Steep paths, textile cooperatives, and a simple lake-trout lunch.
bullets: The climb from the dock is slow at this altitude.
Boat back to Puno in the late afternoon.

evening.name: Dinner in Puno
evening.description: One dinner near the plaza — keep it simple after the sun and the boat.
bullets: Tomorrow is the bus or flight to Arequipa.

days.title: Puno to Arequipa
days.travelHack: A morning JUL–AQP hop is worth the fare versus the 6-hour bus — you arrive with a full afternoon in the white city.
days.transportationTips: Juliaca (JUL) is ~1 h from Puno. Taxi to the airport, then a short flight to Arequipa.
days.localWarnings: Arequipa is ~2,300 m — easier than Puno. You will feel the extra oxygen.

morning.name: Transfer to Juliaca and flight to Arequipa
morning.description: Leave the Altiplano for the white-stone city under El Misti.
bullets: Allow 90 min Puno → JUL including check-in.
Keep a layer; Arequipa evenings are cool.

afternoon.name: Plaza de Armas and a first walk in sillar stone
afternoon.description: The cathedral and arcades — no museum rush on arrival day.
bullets: Sit on the plaza and look up at El Misti if the sky is clear.
Santa Catalina can wait until tomorrow.

evening.name: Dinner in Arequipa
evening.description: One dinner — rocoto relleno or a simple chupe, not a tasting menu after travel.
bullets: Book Santa Catalina for the morning.

days.title: Arequipa — Santa Catalina and Yanahuara
days.travelHack: Santa Catalina is a half-day if you go at opening — the colour-washed lanes empty out after the first tour groups.
days.transportationTips: The center is walkable. Taxi up to Yanahuara viewpoint, walk back if you have the legs.

morning.name: Monasterio de Santa Catalina
morning.description: A city inside the city — blue and terracotta lanes, cloisters, and kitchens.
bullets: Go at opening; 2 hours is enough.
A licensed guide for the first 45 min helps the layout.

afternoon.name: Yanahuara viewpoint and San Camilo market
afternoon.description: Volcano arches, then fruit and juices in the market.
bullets: Yanahuara is the postcard of El Misti.
Confirm tomorrow’s Colca pickup time tonight.

evening.name: Dinner in Arequipa
evening.description: One dinner — alpaca or a vegetarian Novoandina plate.
bullets: Early night; Colca vans leave before dawn.

days.title: To Colca Canyon — Chivay
days.travelHack: Do Colca as two days with a night in Chivay — the one-day dash from Arequipa is 15 hours and you miss the condors at first light.
days.transportationTips: Shared van Arequipa → Chivay ~3.5–4 h via the high pass (Patapampa ~4,800 m).
days.localWarnings: The pass is higher than Cusco. Coca tea and a slow walk on arrival.

morning.name: Van Arequipa to Chivay via Patapampa
morning.description: High-pass transfer into the Colca valley.
bullets: Vicunas at the lookout if the group stops.
Keep water; the air is dry on the pass.

afternoon.name: Chivay village and La Calera hot springs
afternoon.description: Check in, then a soak — the classic Colca first afternoon.
bullets: The pools are the recovery after the pass.
Confirm the 05:00 Cruz del Cóndor pickup.

evening.name: Dinner in Chivay
evening.description: One dinner on the plaza — early, then sleep.
bullets: Dawn start for the condors.

days.title: Cruz del Cóndor and flight to Lima
days.travelHack: Book a late-afternoon AQP–LIM flight — Cruz del Cóndor plus the drive back needs the morning.
days.transportationTips: Dawn van to Cruz del Cóndor, back through Chivay to Arequipa airport (~6–7 h total road).

morning.name: Cruz del Cóndor viewpoint
morning.description: Andean condors riding the canyon thermals — go at first light.
bullets: Stand at the rail; the birds often pass below you.
If the sky is empty, wait 20 min before giving up.

afternoon.name: Return to Arequipa and flight to Lima
afternoon.description: Van back to AQP, then the hop to the coast.
bullets: Keep the day bag ready for the airport.
Lima evening is grey and cool after the canyon sun.

evening.name: Farewell dinner in Miraflores
evening.description: One dinner — ceviche or grilled fish after the Andes.
bullets: International departure is tomorrow.

days.title: Departure from Lima
days.travelHack: LIM international: arrive 3 hours early. The new terminal still has uneven signage.
days.transportationTips: Pre-booked transfer or official airport taxi. Allow 60–90 min from Miraflores.

morning.name: Transfer to LIM and international departure
bullets: Keep soles for the last taxi if the card fails.
Water after security — the air on the climb-out is dry.
